post: Week 3 · Sun · How we help ABC learners move forward (carousel version of the founder + leader conversation)
caption:
What happens when you get stuck inside AI Builder's Camp? 🤔

You're never on your own. Here's how we help builders keep moving, week after week:

📅 A Saturday main session to learn the big idea
🛠️ A Tuesday hands-on lab to build it with guidance
🤝 Small-group coaching to get unstuck with your coach
▶️ Replays and a community for when life gets busy
✅ One weekly task, so progress adds up

By week 8: your purpose blueprint, your own digital product, and a plan to sell it.

Have a question about ABC? Drop it in the comments or send us a message. Batch 3 is coming. 👉 aibuilderscamp.ph

#AIBuildersCamp #AIEmpoweredClub #YourAIBestie
